lines.dialogue: It’s mine! My own. It came to me. SMÉAGOL My Precious. DISSOLVE TO:

lines.scene: EXT. CULVERT, VALE OF MORGUL – DAWN
lines.dialogue: Wake up! Wake up! Wake up, sleepies! We must go, yes, we must go at once!

lines.scene: EXT. CULVERT, VALE OF MORGUL – DAWN
lines.dialogue: Come on, must go, no time...

lines.scene: EXT. CULVERT, VALE OF MORGUL – DAWN
lines.dialogue: ... no time to lose, silly.

lines.scene: EXT. CULVERT, VALE OF MORGUL - DAY
lines.dialogue: Come, Hobbitses. Very close now. Very close to Mordor! No safe places here. Hurry! Shhh.
Shhh! Quiet!
Mustn’t waken them, mustn't ruin it now! SMÉAGOL They knows, they knows, they suspects us!
What's it saying, my Precious, my love? Is Sméagol losing his nerve?? SMÉAGOL No! Not! Never!! Sméagol hates nasty Hobbitses! Sméagol wants to see them – dead!
And we will ... Sméagol did it once... ... He can do it again.
It's ours - ours! Final Revision - October, 2003 12. SMÉAGOL We must get the Precious. We must get it back.
Patience, patience, my love. First, we must lead them to her. SMÉAGOL We lead them to the windy stairs.
Yes, the stairs ... and then? SMÉAGOL Up, up, up, up the stairs we go ... until we come to... ... the Tunnel!
And when they go in, there's no coming out. She's always hungry, she always needs to feed. She must eat. All she gets is filthy Orcses. SMÉAGOL And they doesn't taste very nice, does they, Precious?
No ...not very nice at all, my love. She hungers for sweeter meats...
“Hobbit meat.” And when She throws away the bones and the empty clothes, then we will find it... SMÉAGOL And take it for me! Final Revision - October, 2003 13.
For us... SMÉAGOL Yes, we, we meant for us... Gollum! Gollum!
The Precious will be ours, once the Hobbitses are dead!
No! Not! Help! Master!
The Dead City, very nasty place, full of ... enemies.
Quick! Quick! They will see, they will see.
Come away, come away. Look! We have found it.
The way into Mordor! Final Revision - October, 2003 37.
The secret stairs ... climb!
Not that way!
What's it doing?
Hide! Hide! INTERCUT WITH:
Come, Hobbits. We climb - we must climb! Final Revision - October, 2003 40.
Careful, Master - careful! Very far to fall. Very dangerous on the stairs.
Come, Master. Final Revision - October, 2003 50.
Come to Sméagol.
Master carries heavy burden ... Sméagol Knows ... Heavy, heavy burden. Fat one cannot know. Sméagol look after Master.
He wants it - he needs it! Sméagol sees it in his eyes. Very soon, he will ask you for it - you will see ... the Fat One will take it from you. CUT TO:

lines.scene: EXT. PASS OF CIRITH UNGOL, TUNNEL MOUTH - DAY
lines.dialogue: Master must go inside the tunnel.
Orcses filth! Orcses come in here sometimes.
Hurry! GOLLUM (O.S.)(cont’d) This way.
Over here. Final Revision - October, 2003 88.
You will see ... Oh, yes ... You will see.
Naughty little fly, Why does it cry?
Caught in her web, Soon you'll be... ...Eaten!

lines.scene: EXT. PASS OF CIRITH UNGOL - DAY
lines.dialogue: Got away did it, Precious? Not this time, not this time! Final Revision - October, 2003 92. SMÉAGOL It wasn't us! It wasn't us! Sméagol wouldn't hurt master. SMÉAGOL (cont’d) Sméagol promised. You must believe us. It was the Precious! The Precious made us do it!

lines.scene: EXT. SLOPES OF MOUNT DOOM - DAY
lines.dialogue: Clever Hobbits to climb so high! Final Revision - October, 2003 132. INTERCUT WITH:
Precious! Precious! Final Revision - October, 2003 137. INTERCUT WITH:
My Precious... GALADRIEL (V.O.) (CONT’D) The Ring came to the creature Gollum, who took it deep into the tunnels of the Misty Mountains. 6. GALADRIEL (V.O.) (CONT’D) And there it consumed him.

It came to me. My own. My love... My preciousness. GALADRIEL (V.O.) (CONT’D) The Ring gave to Gollum unnatural long life. For five hundred years it poisoned his mind. And in the gloom of Gollum's cave...
Lost! Lost! My Precious is lost!! DISSOLVE TO: GALADRIEL (V.O.) For the time will soon come when Hobbits will shape the fortunes of all. DISSOLVE TO:
Shire! Baggins!! CUT TO:
S...Shire! Baggins! CUT TO:
We wants it. We needs it.
Must have the precious. They stole it from us. Sneaky little Hobbitses. Wicked. Tricksy. False. SMÉAGOL No. Not Master.
Yes, precious. False. They will cheat you, hurt you, lie! SMÉAGOL Master’s my friend.
You don’t have any friends. Nobody likes you. SMÉAGOL Not listening. I’m not listening.
You’re a liar and a thief. SMÉAGOL No. 105.
Murderer. SMÉAGOL Go away.
Go away? SMÉAGOL I hate you. I hate you.
Where would you be without me? Gollum. Gollum. I saved us. It was me. We survived because of me. SMÉAGOL Not anymore.
What did you say? SMÉAGOL Master looks after us now. We don’t need you.
What? SMÉAGOL Leave now and never come back. 106.

No. SMÉAGOL Leave now and never come back. SMÉAGOL (CONT’D) Leave now and never come back! SMÉAGOL (CONT’D) We told him to go away. And away he goes, precious. SMÉAGOL (CONT’D) Gone! Gone! Gone! Sméagol is free! CUT TO:
Look. Look. See what Sméagol finds?
They are young. 107.
They are tender. They are nice. Yes, they are. Eat them. Eat them!
What’s he doing? Stupid, fat Hobbit. It ruins it.
What’s taters, precious? What’s taters? Eh?
Oh, yes, we could. Spoil a nice fish.
Give it to us raw and wriggling. You keep nasty chips.
Wicked Men. Servants of Sauron. They are called to Mordor. The Dark One is gathering all armies to him. It won’t be long now. He will soon be ready.
To make his war. The last war that will cover all the world in Shadow.
We must go now?
Master! 155.
Sméagol. Why does it cry, Sméagol? SMÉAGOL Cruel Men hurts us. Master tricksed us.
Of course he did.
I told you he was tricksy. I told you he was false. 156. SMÉAGOL Master is our friend ... our friend.
Master betrayed us. SMÉAGOL No. Not its business. Leave us alone!
Filthy little Hobbitses. They stole it from us! SMÉAGOL No ... No.
My Precious! CUT TO:
No. No!
Yes.
It is the only way. Master says we must go to Mordor, so we must try.
Save me?
No, no, no hard feelings. Gollum, Gollum. Yes, master.
Nice Hobbits.
Master broke his promise. SMÉAGOL Don’t ask Sméagol. Poor, poor Sméagol.

Master betrayed us. Wicked. Tricksy. False. We ought to wring his filthy little neck. Kill him! Kill him! Kill them both. And then we take the precious and we be the master! SMÉAGOL But the fat Hobbit, he knows. Eyes always watching.
Then we stabs them out. Put out his eyeses and make him crawl. 220. SMÉAGOL Yes! Yes! Yes!
Kill them both. SMÉAGOL Yes! No! No! SMÉAGOL It’s too risky. It’s too risky.
We could let her do it. SMÉAGOL Yes. She could do it.
Yes, precious, she could. And then we takes it once they’re dead. SMÉAGOL Once they’re dead.
Shh. 221. SMÉAGOL Come on, Hobbits. Long ways to go yet. Sméagol will show you the way.
Follow me.
